fields.System.Title: OUT-302 — Preview wave workload
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to see how much work a wave contains before I release it, so
that I do not release more than the shift can finish before the cut-off.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a planned wave, then I see order count, line count, unit count, and estimated
  • pick time.
  • - Given the preview, then it breaks work down by zone so I can see where the load falls.
  • - Given lines that cannot be picked because stock is missing, then they are listed
  • before release.
  • - Given pick faces that will run below minimum during the wave, then they are listed
  • with the replenishment needed.
  • - Given the estimate, then it is compared against the cut-off and a warning shown if it
  • will not finish.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | wave, order_line, stock_balance |
| Risks | Wave too large to finish before cut-off ([doc 05 WF 5](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
